land.eyebrow: Group polls · Time slots · No sign-up
land.lede: Meld turns “where should we eat?” into a decision in under a minute. Make a poll, share a link, and watch your group vote live, with ranked choice, time slots and a result worth sharing.
land.videoAria: Two people using Meld: creating a ranked poll, voting live, going offline and crowning the winner
land.whyTitle: Everything a group decision needs. Nothing it doesn't.
land.f1b: No accounts, emails or passwords. Make a poll, share the link, and everyone votes from any phone or laptop.
land.f2b: Vote on a train or in a basement. Meld saves everything on your device and syncs the moment you reconnect.
land.f3b: Let people order their favourites. Instant runoff finds the option most of the group can live with.
land.f4b: Offer time slots, check them against your calendar, and send the winning time to Google or Apple Calendar.
land.f5b: Design a geometric avatar, or vote behind an anonymous mask when honesty matters more than names.
land.f6b: A live push arena, deadlines with countdowns, Present mode for screen sharing, and a result card to post anywhere.
land.s1b: Type a question and a few options: a quick poll, a ranked vote, or time slots. Add a deadline if you want one.
land.s2b: Send the link or show the QR code. Friends vote in their browser; Android users can use the app.
land.s3b: Watch votes arrive live. Crown the winner in one tap, or let the deadline close it for you.
land.iWebhooks: Signed JSON when a poll is decided
land.iEmbeds: A live, votable poll on any website
land.iWeeklyBody: A fresh poll every week, one link
land.trustTitle: No ads. No trackers. Open source.
land.trustBody: Meld has no accounts, ads or analytics. Rooms can only be opened with their code. The whole app is MIT-licensed on GitHub, and you can read exactly what it does.
land.finalTitle: Your group's next decision is one link away.
faq.q1: Do I need an account to use Meld?
faq.a1: No. Nobody signs up: not you, not the people voting. Make a poll, share the link or QR code, and anyone can vote from a phone or laptop browser.
faq.a2: Yes. Meld is free and open source under the MIT license, with no ads, no tracking and no premium tier.
faq.a3: Yes. Votes and polls are saved on your device first and sync automatically when you reconnect, on both the Android app and the installable web app.
faq.q4: How does ranked-choice voting work in Meld?
faq.a4: Each person orders the options. Meld runs an instant runoff: the option with the fewest first choices is removed and its votes move to the next choice, until one option has a majority.
faq.q5: Can Meld find a time that works for everyone?
faq.a5: Yes. Create a time-slot poll, let people mark the times they can make, and send the winning slot to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar in one tap.
faq.q6: Can I use Meld in Slack or Discord?
faq.a6: Yes. Type /meld with a question and options to start a poll in a Slack or Discord channel. The result is posted back when the poll closes. Webhooks and website embeds are available too.
faq.a7: Meld is available in 18 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Chinese, on both Android and the web.
